description: This file defines the SerialIoStream class which implements the IoStream interface for serial port communication, handling operations like open, close, write, purge, and setting input listeners using the jssc SerialPort library.

classes.name: SerialIoStream
classes.description: Implements serial port communication via the jssc SerialPort library, providing methods to write, close, purge, and listen to data on a serial port.

methods.name: SerialIoStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SerialIoStream with a SerialPort and Logger.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the serial port and logs the operation.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes bytes to the serial port.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Purges the RX and TX buffers of the serial port.

methods.name: setInputListener
methods.description: Sets a DataListener to receive incoming serial port data.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Returns whether the serial port has been closed.
